name: prompt-coach
description: Checks each prompt before Claude starts: clear ones go straight through, unclear ones come back to the prompt box with a grade, tips and a rewrite to use or edit

language.title: Advice language
language.description: Language of the grade verdict, tips and weekly review (zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English). Rewrites keep the prompt's own language.

model.title: Coach model
model.description: Model that grades each prompt. Each prompt you send costs one extra call on your account.
